# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a vivid, black-eyed girl who carried off the palm for beauty in her Second Year classes at Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Stella has a heart full of wistful, rainbow-like dreams and fancies. She is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious, though she occasionally experiences moments of discouragement or brain fag. She takes matters of the heart seriously and dislikes seeing people toy with others' affections. Additionally, she can be particular about domestic order and cleanliness.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c16 P15](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0015), [v3 c16 P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023), [v3 c16 P49](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0049), [v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 c25 P24](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0024), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031), [v3 c35 P32](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0032)_

- Thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- Imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Goals

- Achieve high academic honors at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>

## History

Stella studied at Queen's Academy, where she became a close friend of Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant. After graduating, she spent time teaching school before deciding to resume her education at Redmond College. She proposed that the friends set up a shared home, renting Patty's Place along with her Aunt Jamesina to keep house for them. After completing her degree at Redmond with good all-round standing, Stella moved to Vancouver to teach.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_

## Quotes

> I give you up,  <sub>[v3 c25 P24](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0024)</sub>

> I'm blue and discouraged myself. Nothing seems worthwhile. My very thoughts are old. I've thought them all before. What is the use of living after all, Anne?  <sub>[v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)</sub>

> I like it when it stays on the roof. It doesn't always. I spent a gruesome night in an old country farmhouse last summer. The roof leaked and the rain came pattering down on my bed. There was no poetry in that. I had to get up in the 'mirk midnight' and chivy round to pull the bedstead out of the drip—and it was one of those solid, old-fashioned beds that weigh a ton—more or less. And then that drip-drop, drip-drop kept up all night until my nerves just went to pieces. You've no idea what an eerie noise a great drop of rain falling with a mushy thud on a bare floor makes in the night. It sounds like ghostly footsteps and all that sort of thing. What are you laughing over, Anne?  <sub>[v3 c35 P37](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0037)</sub>

> ‘There are lots of things that never go by rule, There's a powerful pile o’ knowledge That you never get at college, There are heaps of things you never learn at school,’  <sub>[v3 c37 P16](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0016)</sub>
